description: The line plot illustrates the MRR@10 performance of four different retrieval methods as the number of queries used during inference changes. The x-axis is labeled "Number of queries used during inference ($S$)." and features a linear scale with numeric tick marks at 4, 6, and 8, indicating an interval of 2. The y-axis is labeled "MRR@10" and uses a linear scale ranging from 33.5 to 36.0, with tick marks spaced at intervals of 0.5. The "DPR w/o query" method is depicted by a solid black line with no markers, showing a steady linear increase from approximately 34.3 at the start of the plotted range to roughly 35.8 at the end. The "DPR w/ corpus expansion" method is shown as a solid red line with circular markers; it begins at a value of 35.2 at the first data point and exhibits a continuous upward trend, rising past the 36.0 mark on the y-axis by the sixth data point. The "DPR w/ document expansion" method is represented by a solid green line with upward-pointing triangular markers, demonstrating a steady increase from approximately 34.8 at the first data point to about 36.4 at the final data point. Finally, the "DPR w/ asymmetric expansion" method is indicated by a solid blue line with star markers. It starts at approximately 34.8, rises to 35.2 at the second point, dips slightly to 35.1 at the third point, and then rises to about 35.7 at the fifth point. It experiences another slight dip to 35.6 at the sixth point before rising to 35.9 at the seventh point, remaining relatively steady before ending at approximately 36.0 at the final data point.
